description: Stop cleanly and record everything the next worker needs to continue without rediscovery.

inputs.name: objective
inputs.description: What the task must achieve, from the task record.

inputs.name: acceptanceCriteria
inputs.description: Conditions the result is checked against.

outputs.name: handoff
outputs.description: Summary, completed work, remaining work with paths, open questions and failed attempts.

steps.description: Check the working tree and your receipts: what changed, what passed, what failed.
Name every unfinished item with the file it lives in, including TODO markers you left.
Write down decisions you could not make and failed approaches with their reasons, so they are not repeated.
Write the handoff record the task asks for. It must stand alone: the next worker may not see your conversation.
steps.evidence: The handoff file or artifact receipt.
